card.name: Steroid drug lists before steroid names
card.fires_on: Linking words, commas and word starts just before a steroid or progestin name, such as prednisone, beclomethasone or norethindrone, in drug-interaction or ingredient lists.

modes.label: Joins in corticosteroid lists
modes.description: Commas, 'and', 'including' or 'to' right before the next corticosteroid is named.
modes.example: Alternative corticosteroids including beclomethasone<<,>> prednisone, and prednisol

modes.label: Start of progestin names
modes.description: The first letter of norethindrone or norgestimate when it is split off from the rest of the name.
modes.example: Includes low-dose COCs containing the following progestins:<< n>>orgestimate, norethindrone

card.plain: It lights up in the gap just before a steroid drug name is expected to appear.
